title: Anaya's first day at school.
lines: Anaya is three and a half years old.
Her daddy and mummy come from India, and at home they speak Hindi.
But Anaya lives in Antwerp, and today is a very big day.
Today she is going to school for the first time, to nursery class!
It's purple, with a unicorn on it.
There's a little paratha in it, and pieces of apple, and a cookie.
Come on, says Daddy, let's go!
But on the pavement outside the school Anaya stops.
Anaya knows a little Dutch, but she's a bit scared.
Everyone is a little bit scared on their first day.
And I'll come and get you later.
The teacher comes over to them.
She has curly hair and a cheerful smile.
Anaya says very quietly: Hello, Miss.
There's a doll corner, a building corner, a reading corner and a big table with paint.
Miss Lies gives her a hug.
Come on, says the teacher, would you like to make a drawing?
Anaya sits down at the table.
Next to her sits a girl with a ponytail.
What are you going to draw?
There are lots of elephants in India.
Can I draw an elephant too?
A grey one and a pink one.
At playtime Anaya and Lotte play on the slide.
At lunchtime Anaya opens her lunchbox.
Do you want to taste it?
And Lotte gives Anaya a piece of her cheese sandwich.
After lunch the teacher sings a song.
Anaya doesn't know the words yet, but she claps along.
And then Anaya teaches the class a word in Hindi.
That means hello, she says, with her hands pressed together.
At three o'clock Mummy is standing at the school gate.
Am I going to school again tomorrow?
